property_summary: For every direct call to setOwner(newOwner) the contract's owner becomes newOwner iff the caller (msg.sender) was the prior owner; the mutant that uses tx.origin allows a call where msg.sender is a forwarding contract (not the owner) but tx.origin is the owner to change ownership, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner); with require(tx.origin == owner); so onlyOwner checks tx.origin instead of msg.sender.
